label: Device Dive
description: A phone showing the product, then the camera pushes THROUGH its screen until the screen is the frame (the bezel sweeps past the edges) and the full-size product (after_src) takes over, with optional cards floating in at different depths. 'From the phone in your pocket to the whole platform' in one continuous move.

src.label: Screen image on the phone (a mobile screenshot)

after_src.label: Full-frame image once inside (a desktop screenshot / the full UI)

layers.label: Cards floating in after arrival: {src or text, x, y (% of frame), w (% width, images), depth (0.5-1.5)}

at.label: Seconds into the scene it enters (default 0.2)
